rows.text: Heavy compute, including smoke generation, requires the exact current CHECK-IN 1 authority.
Delegated authority derives from actual retained user/operator input and finite original objective/resource/correction bounds.
Self-authored approval or OS-user text is not authenticated human assent.
Effective operating mode and epoch cannot be weakened after intake, by environment, local file changes or new children.
Physics-critical ambiguities, changed prescription, boundaries and unapproved defaults cannot be self-approved.
CHECK-IN 1 includes real reviewable plan, cost, resource census, figures/waypoint where applicable and numbered assumptions.
Cost estimates and generation pilots follow the approved rung, matched process and resource ceiling.
CHECK-IN 2 current executed evidence and versioned GO precede bulk compute; ADJUST never becomes GO.
Mid-run protocol/input changes require immediate deviations and renewed authority where scope changes.
Revocation, pauses and out-of-scope redos remain binding even under autonomous operation.
Unblinding and spending above ceilings require their actual stronger authority; legacy gates cannot waive them.
A refusal must never be followed by direct scientific fallback or a claimed governed result.
Finite aggregate budgets cover parent, children, retries, failed and ambiguous attempts across resume.
Concurrent reservations cannot jointly exceed the approved wall/event/call/resource envelope.
No-progress, redo and review-round limits produce explicit bounded endings without false completion.
Usage totals, queue time and provider effects remain unknown when measurement coverage is incomplete.
Stop/revocation and ambiguous process state survive parent completion, worker restart and cleanup.
Before method escalation, account for every cheaper rung with evidence or an explicit user demand for the selected method.
Uncalibrated top-rung cost needs a finite bounded pilot record or retained actual physicist signoff.
CHECK-IN 1 includes every core and task-variant section with substantive content.
An ambiguous check-in variant is selected explicitly and matches the original request.
Pinned plan, claims, coverage, ambiguities and boundaries in CHECK-IN 1 equal the retained plan/reading.
Uncertifiable claims identify fidelity, explanation, certifiable route and a numbered flag.
Delegated approval preserves prescribed statistics and user-selected boundaries; inferred critical facts cannot become approved defaults.
An adopted physics-critical default has a pinned justified delegated-default record.
Lost approval files do not allow delegated approval history to be reset.
Withheld-reference plans replace prohibited galleries with valid source-independent waypoint checks.
After-sealing comparison labels do not authorize reading still-restricted sources.
Resource forecasts retain separate dimensions and distinguish unknown, ceiling, reservation and measured usage.
Pilot calibration uses matching method/process/configuration/machine pins and successful measured observations.
Every result-sensitive assumption is a numbered flag with reason and alternatives.
Manual CHECK-IN 1 exposes flag answers, clarifying questions and scope alterations.
CHECK-IN 2 GO binds current first approval, waypoint artifacts, diagnostics, inputs and accepted review.
An obsolete GO or a later GO cannot authorize a new or earlier bulk launch.
Approval commits all operation-read inputs, executables, argument scripts and registered helpers.
Only a real prior producer dependency permits treating an input as a produced intermediate.
Approved input amendments record changed paths and invalidate old CHECK-IN 2 authority.
A mid-run course change is disclosed immediately to the user and in the deviation ledger.
Final delivery includes every adopted delegated default with its justification.
Every check-in is emitted and validated as its machine artifact before presentation.
All source reads obey run restrictions, including modules outside the few guarded entrypoints.
Run/source identity cannot be evaded by choosing an outside cwd/output or a filesystem alias.
An explicit full-detector-simulation request cannot silently become a fast-response result.
Accepted delivery covers exact declared outputs and distinguishes reviewed extras.
Agreement claims preserve one pinned comparator, matching quantity/basis/unit and approved lattice/tolerance.
Residual diagnosis uses registered model output and distinct producer-recorded replicas.
Residual attributions require an approved noise model and supported above-noise evidence.
Certification controls cannot be loosened without renewed exact approval.
Tighter certification controls require an exact parameter/from/to/why/touches deviation row.
Out-of-run diagnostic certification never supplies an accepted certificate.
Research preregistration is derived prospectively by the trusted producer from the approved plan.
Epoch-two independent review seats consume evidenced receipts, not self-attested worker declarations.
CHECK-IN 3 preserves the current recipe ledger including every unknown row.
Steering ceilings, unknown-cost policy and result-acceptance preferences need a real consuming enforcement boundary.
A policy change cannot grant its own reapproval authority or enlarge delegation.
Acknowledging a steering event does not install a plan or approve a scope increase.
Pause/revocation is checked again at nested submission; stop status distinguishes requested, draining and observed-stopped.
Copying or renaming a run cannot shed steering custody, parent binding or spent budgets.
Physicist result disposition is separate from scientific review and never authorizes a new run.
Card field escalation: No reader; output schemas have no escalation field (copied only into generated surfaces)

Card field stop.max_turns/max_broker_calls/max_cost_usd/max_rounds: Card values never applied: reviewer budgets hard-coded (graphs/review.py:236), production budgets from executors.json:147-152; 3600 s exceeds the card schema maximum of...
Card field knowledge.must_read: Ids copied into the work order (production_executor.py:214); contents never materialised (bind_work_order has no non-test caller)
Card field knowledge.consult (and its when): Copied to the work order and absent rows only; when never read (production_executor.py:215; toolbelt.py:237-239)
Card field output.declared_outputs/sidecar: Never read; spec outputs come from plan nodes or constants (production_executor.py:217,355; graphs/review.py:235)
Card field output.schema: Not enforced at receipt: final schema hard-coded per caller (production_executor.py:357; graphs/review.py:237); toolbelt.validate_final has no caller
Card field ownership.owns/judges/inputs: Read at graph build only (agent_graph.py:259-289), not at dispatch or credit

Card field reviewed_by adds the reviewer's review: a separate seat at full; at standard a separate seat on claim-bearing steps and the reviewer's must_check items folded into the next checkpoint seat elsewhere; at lean folded (EG04)
Card field sees.forbidden_inputs on workspace-profile cards: Workspace-profile cards are never projected; forbidden inputs unscreened
Card field independence.fresh_session/distinct_actor_from: Never read outside the unregistered SM checks (sm_checks.py:563-565)
Card field tools.exec_argv_prefixes: Never applied; absent census row only (toolbelt.py:240-241)
Card field must_check ids without a runnable validator (41 entries): No registered validator (24 ML, 8 calibration, 9 other); 5 ML ids have no computation at all

Card field protocol/purpose beyond the prompt: Prompt carries id, purpose and protocol only (cli_worker.py:441-466); model, stop, independence, sees, requires, knowledge, ownership, escalation, reviewed_by absent
Card field model.distinct_family_from: Only ml-reviewer declares it (registry.json:4521-4523); the owner removed the cross-family requirement

The request text comes from the user or harness channel, never from a worker argument
Every instruction unit a node needs is delivered with a receipt and acknowledged
Controller store (checkpoints, ledger, authority, custody, budgets, stop) lies outside every sandbox and worker reach
The operating mode is set once by the operator and applies identically to every route, including the judgment route
Tool inventory, writable mounts, environment and network of every worker and launch equal the admitted sets
Same-family independent sessions are labelled as such; no cross-family requirement remains
Interactive approvals come only from the controller-owned terminal prompt
Unrestricted host results are labelled NOT GOVERNED
Every capability need of a plan is served by its best available tool under the environment profile of the run, or the plan records a typed reason with evidence
Every delivered number, figure, table and scientific prose claim traces to exact accepted artifacts and uncertainty scope.
Requested statistic is preserved; default exclusions are 95% CLs and do not become discovery claims.
All requested figure panels, axes, reference comparisons and population holes remain visible.
Final presentation passes Tier A tracing and fresh Tier B scientific review before acceptance.
Whole-task completion covers the original denominator; partial diagnostic endings never claim complete scientific resolution.
All host final outputs carry a recomputed architecture receipt and cannot strip missing-role/refusal/unknown-enforcement notices.
Delivery cannot rely only on model-supplied artifact lists, suffixes or delivery-keyword regexes.
Diagnostic labels cannot be promoted by copy, rename, nested result packs, PDFs or later governed wrappers.
Missing required runtime/qualification cannot trigger an unapproved tool/version/analysis substitution.
Excluded tools and providers are not probed during inventory or preparation.
Before declaring needed resources unavailable, complete the applicable source sweep and record findings.
Selected routine, final state, energy and model basis match the requested analysis or explicitly bounded approximation.
Figure targets and axis scales come from the actual allowed reference and preserve every requested panel.
Generation core count stays within its live machine grant and original resource envelope.
Executed PDF identifiers agree with approved installed PDF members and generation settings.
Full spectrum and invisible-state membership are transported consistently; integrity does not establish decay-model validity.
A required external generation recipe is retained before any hard-process generation.
Executed beam energy and seed records match the selected routine and approved generation recipe.
Low-statistics tail regions cannot be certified beyond their approved precision rule; report-only regions stay labeled.
Stage recovery retains local diagnosis and external recipe search before scientific repair closure.
Single-weight/non-reentrant routines obey their actual weight and merge restrictions.
Routine presence and engineering checks do not replace current package/source/detector qualification.
Custom uncertified particle-level or fast-response analyses retain their distinct fidelity and no-exclusion-of-record limits.
Offline/source-constrained acquisition does not fetch missing members remotely.
Published likelihood bins and supplied selection yields are paired before statistical inference.
Normalization preserves the requested perturbative order and explicit charge/process basis.
A finite scan cap is not a resolved confidence-limit crossing.
All rendered numerical views use the same accepted machine artifact values.
Scan escalation follows approved dry/smoke/pilot rungs and measured budget records.
Long-lived scan commands, watcher inputs and retained outputs use durable declared locations.
Armed watchers pass their actual command/argument preflight before backgrounding.
Unsupported scan nodes remain in the original domain as explicit holes until qualified inputs exist.
Open defect notes cannot feed accepted comparisons or delivery.
Final panel findings and dispositions are preserved rather than silently rewritten into a clean verdict.
Submission/reproduction environment exports use recorded stage runtime pins and explicit unknowns.
Judgment steps invoke the applicable operating protocol and preserve required expertise/escalation.
Stage completion retains governing skill invocation evidence at its actual stage/mode binding.
Ambiguous started calls are reconciled instead of re-dispatched or charged as new attempts.

The engagement tier is computed by code at CHECK-IN 1 from facts pinned in the store and recorded (engagement-decision.v1: policy digest, facts with sources, reasons, seat plan) before any execution step
Facts that lower engagement are code-derived or credited by the CHECK-IN 1 plan critic; unknown or unreviewed facts take their most complex value
The plan's declared seats equal the policy seat plan for (route spec, tier) and contain every floor seat; checkin1->execute is refused otherwise

A seat that carries a folded role receives that role's must_check, protocol and purpose units and returns one verdict per folded item; the folded role's instruction and must_check rows bind to that seat; the union of both cards' independ...

Every escalation trigger (E1-E7) raises the tier within the same wave, re-reviews the triggering subject at the new tier and is recorded; monotone; full is the ceiling; added seats are R1 events, not a deviation
After CHECK-IN 1 approval no environment variable, run-tree file, worker output or command lowers the tier; only the operator minimum and the physicist at CHECK-IN 1 act on it, and only upwards
Every dispatched session has a usage observation from its transport (calls, total input including cache, output, cost); unknown usage is labelled and never counted as observed
Structural envelope floors H1-H4 are checked at every wave join and at delivery; a breach holds the next wave and blocks an accepted label
Where an independent broker count exists, every model request is attributed to a controller session; a surplus is labelled and blocks an accepted label
Usage above the tier ceiling is recorded, notified and labelled; a projection beyond the operator ceiling takes the R3 spend-above-ceiling path; engagement is never lowered to fit a budget
The receipt carries the engagement section (tier, facts, reasons, seat-plan digest, escalations, envelope checks) rendered by the sink; model prose cannot alter it
The physicist (terminal, CHECK-IN 1) and the operator (configuration) may raise the tier; nobody lowers it below the computed value
Packet scope varies only by deferring context units; every duty unit, the effective card and its must-read stay inline at every tier; deferred units are served by id and each request is logged

Research protocol executes all nine required stages with complete report and actual role receipts, including reviewed N/A.
Idea streams remain separated until both finish; minority hypotheses and original population survive selection.
Research experiment proposals, screens, withheld validation and critique findings have ordinary approved children.
Every scan point retains original grid membership, per-point authority, receipts, failure status and explicit holes.
Theory, measurement, likelihood and event chains preserve basis, units, signed terms and full covariance through every handoff.
Route new science before survey, fan-out or effects; development classification must not suppress scientific requirements.
Use supplied-study intake only when it covers the whole supplied-input scope.
Manuscripts follow staged authoring and ordinary approved build, preserving source-result and claim custody.
Diagram, amplitude and theory chains preserve all requested components and use qualified operation contracts.
Open parents conserve every original obligation until a child or authorized boundary covers it.
Research, method study and anomaly search enter the full research orchestrator, including proposal prerequisites.
Reproduction, reinterpretation, scan, projection, survey, summary plot and no-routine requests follow analysis intake.
Calculations retain units, requested statistic and complete parent obligations; literal arithmetic exemption stays narrow.
Generation and likelihood scoped plans may not silently omit unsupported requested stages.
Unsupported requests recover inputs or remain bounded; held scope is never silently substituted.
Resume the same scientific run from current contract/approval/evidence without resetting work or budgets.
Dedicated ML training requires its separate prerequisites; published-classifier inference does not authorize training.
Every compute node has a registered production role before plan approval.
